summary: Fingerprint copied installed trees for cache freshness and leave snapshots before EXIT cleanup.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only v3 generation key keeps public/private input digests and adds an authoritative stat fingerprint of installed dependencies. Source drift during population refuses publication. Earlier key formats are not migrated in place.

recovery.detail: Cleanup enters a stable cwd before snapshot removal. Recoverable cleanup errors are warnings and preserve a successful build status; unsafe rollback or inability to enter a stable cwd remains an error.
